title: ModuleGraph
description: Complete analysis result for a project

schemaVersion.description: Version of the output schema. Consumers check this to detect breaking changes in the JSON structure.

modules.description: Analysis results for each module in the project.

ca.description: Afferent coupling — the number of modules that depend on this module.

ce.description: Efferent coupling — the number of modules this module depends on.

instability.description: Instability metric I = Ce / (Ca + Ce), in [0, 1].

distance.description: Distance from main sequence D = |A + I - 1|, in [0, 1].

lcom.description: Lack of Cohesion of Methods (LCOM4 variant); the number of connected components.

exportedTypes.description: Total count of exported types in this module.

abstractTypes.description: Count of abstract types (e.g., Go interfaces, Python ABCs).

zone.description: Classification of the module's position relative to the main sequence.

totalLines.description: Total number of lines across all source files in this module. Zero indicates the line count could not be determined.

duplications.description: Detected structurally similar code blocks within this module. An empty array indicates no duplications were detected.

modulePath.description: Unique identifier for the module containing the duplicate blocks.

blocks.description: Locations of the duplicate code blocks. At least two blocks per duplication.

file.description: Path to the source file containing this block, relative to the project root.

startLine.description: 1-indexed line number where the duplicate block begins.

endLine.description: 1-indexed line number where the duplicate block ends (inclusive).

lineCount.description: Number of significant lines in this block, excluding blank lines and single-token lines.

similarity.description: Structural similarity score between the blocks, in [0, 1]. 1.0 means structurally identical after normalization.

extensions.description: Language-specific metric extensions namespaced by language (e.g., "go.interfaceWidth").

cycles.description: Detected circular dependencies between modules, each reported as a lexicographically-sorted set of module paths.

warnings.description: Language-specific caveats about metric accuracy. Always present (empty when there are none).

module.description: Path of the affected module (empty if the warning applies globally).

provenance.description: Optional metadata about how the graph was produced (producer, version, timestamp, input). Omitted for byte-reproducible output.

producer.description: Name of the tool that produced the graph (e.g., "vibe-check").

version.description: Semantic version of the producing tool (e.g., "0.1.0").

generatedAt.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at which the graph was produced.

input.description: Identifies the source that was analyzed.

path.description: Path to the analyzed project directory.
